blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: People often attach instructions to their search queries, asking for pages written for beginners, documents in a certain language or official sources only. Most rerankers were trained to judge topical relevance and treat such instructions as a few extra words. On the InfoSearch benchmark, even GPT-4o used as a list-wise reranker reaches an average WISE (Weighted Instruction Sensitivity Evaluation) of only 33.5. We present DMReranker (Decision-Model Reranker), a zero-shot reranker that splits an instructed query into a topic and a short list of typed clauses. A small judge model answers one narrow question per clause, and the answer probabilities are multiplied into a single score. Nothing is trained, and the configuration was frozen before the test runs. Reranking the same top-100 candidates as the published baselines, DMReranker reaches a macro WISE of 50.9 over all six InfoSearch dimensions while keeping original-mode nDCG@10 at 82.9. It trails GPT-4o on the stricter SICR (Strict Instruction Compliance Ratio) metric, 19.2 against 32.1. We show that this gap follows from how a product of probabilities behaves when SICR compares raw scores across runs. Computed from ranks, our SICR is 67.0. On the same judge, splitting the instruction raises WISE from 32.9 to 47.6 over a single combined question, while raw-score SICR falls. Scoring all six dimensions cost about $10 at list price.
blocks.zh: 人们常常在搜索查询中附加指示,要求为初学者撰写网页,只使用某种语言或官方来源的文件. 大多数重新排名者都接受了判断专题相关性的培训,并将此类指示作为几个额外的词来对待. 在InfoSearch基准上,即使是作为列表重排器使用的GPT-4o也只达到33.5的WISE(加权指令敏感性评价)平均值. 我们介绍 DMRanker(决定-模式Ranker),一个零发重排,将一个指示的查询分为一个话题和一个打出的条款的短列表. 一个小法官模型每个条款回答一个狭义的问题,答案概率被乘以一分. 没有经过训练,配置在测试运行前被冻结. DMReranker将与公布的基线相同的前100名候选人重新排序,在所有6个信息搜索维度上达到50.9的宏WISE,同时将原始模式nDCG@10保持在82.9. 它跟踪了GPT-4o更严格的SICR(Strict Teach understanding rate)度量衡,19.2比32.1. 我们显示,这一差距源于一种概率产物在SICR对比生分横跑时的表现. 从队伍计算,我们的SICR是67.0. 在同一名法官身上,将教学分开,将WISE从32.9提高到47.6,放在一个综合问题上,而原始分数SICR则下降。 6个维度都按列表价格计算成本约10美元.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A search query used to be a handful of keywords. Today it is often a sentence with conditions attached. A developer asks how to tune indexes in a database and adds that only the official documentation is useful. A student wants an explanation of photosynthesis that a twelve-year-old could follow. A reader wants news coverage in Spanish. In each case the user cares about two things at once, whether a document is about the right topic and whether it has the right properties. A document can be perfectly on topic and still be useless because it is a forum post, written for experts, or in the wrong language.
blocks.zh: 搜索查询曾经是少数关键词. 今天,它常常是一个附加条件的句子。 一个开发者询问如何调用数据库中的索引,并补充说只有官方文档是有用的. 一个学生想要对光合作用的解释 一个12岁的孩子可以跟着。 读者希望用西班牙语报道新闻。 在每一种情况下,用户同时关心两个问题,一个文档是否涉及正确的话题,以及它是否有正确的属性. 一个文件可以完美地讨论话题,但依然无用,因为它是一个论坛帖子,是为专家写的,或者用错误的语言写.

blocks.en: Rerankers are the natural place to handle such conditions, because they read the query and each candidate document together. Yet most rerankers were built to estimate topical relevance. Cross-encoders such as monoBERT and monoT5 are trained on relevance labels ( Nogueira and Cho, 2019 ; Nogueira et al., 2020 ) , and large language model (LLM) rerankers prompted or distilled for ranking inherit the same goal ( Sun and others, 2023 ; Pradeep et al., 2023a ; Pradeep et al., 2023b ) . Recent benchmarks make the cost of this visible. FollowIR showed that retrieval models largely ignore instructions that change what counts as relevant ( Weller and others, 2025a ) . InfoSearch went further and tested six document-level conditions, namely audience, keyword, format, language, length and source ( Zhou and others, 2025 ) , and scored them with two metrics, WISE (Weighted Instruction Sensitivity Evaluation) and SICR (Strict Instruction Compliance Ratio). On InfoSearch, the strongest reranker reported, GPT-4o used list-wise, reaches an average WISE of 33.5, and the best open model reaches 14.5. Several rerankers score below zero, which means that adding the instruction moved the ranking in the wrong direction.
blocks.zh: 重新排档者是处理这种条件的自然地点,因为他们一起阅读了查询和每个候选文档. 然而,大多数的重新排名是用来估计专题相关性的。 单BERT和单T5等交叉编码器接受相关标签培训(Nogueira and Cho, 2019;Nogueira等, 2020;),并被大语言模型(LLM)再排出或蒸馏后继承了同一项目标(Sun等,2023;Pradeep等,2023a;Pradeep等,2023b.). 最近的基准使这一代价显而易见。 跟随 IR显示,检索模型基本上忽略了改变相关内容的指示(Weller等,2025a)。 InfoSearch更进一步测试了6个文档级别的条件,即受众,关键词,格式,语言,长度和出处(周等,2025年),并用WISE(重度指令灵敏度评价)和SICR(Strict Directing Accessibility Performation)两个度量. 在InfoSearch上,最强的再排名报告,GPT-4o使用列表,平均达到33.5WISE,最佳开放模式达到14.5. 数个重新排行榜得分低于零,这意味着添加指令将排名移向了错误的方向.

blocks.en: We hypothesize that a large part of the problem is the form of the question that the model is asked. A list-wise reranker must weigh topic and conditions together and produce a single ordering, with no explicit place for a condition to veto a document. Our approach breaks the decision into pieces that we expect a model to answer more reliably. We first turn the instruction into a topic and a set of typed clauses. Then, for each candidate, we ask a judge model a series of narrow questions. Is this document relevant to the topic? Which audience is it written for? Is it official documentation? Each answer comes back as a probability. Finally we multiply the probabilities. A document that fails any clause receives a low score, no matter how relevant it is, and a document that satisfies every clause keeps its relevance score almost intact. Figure 1 illustrates the idea on one query, and Figure 2 shows the full architecture.
blocks.zh: 我们假设问题的大部分是 模型被问到的问题的形式。 按清单排列的重新排行符必须把议题和条件放在一起权衡,并产生单一的顺序,对否决文件的条件没有明确的位置。 我们的做法使决定破碎,我们期望一个模式能够更可靠地回答。 我们首先将指示变成一个专题和一套打字条款。 然后,对于每个候选人,我们向一个法官模式提出一系列狭隘的问题。 这份文件是否与本专题相关? 是给哪个观众写的? 是官方文件吗? 每一个答案都作为概率回来。 最后,我们乘以概率。 任何条款的失败文件,无论相关性如何,都获得低分,满足每个条款的文件,其相关性的得分几乎保持不变. 图1用一个查询来说明这个想法,图2则显示整个架构.

blocks.en: This design has three practical benefits. It needs no training data, since each question is one that a general instruction-tuned judge already answers well. Document attributes do not depend on the query, so we profile each document once and reuse the profile for every query that touches it. Finally, every score can be traced back to the individual answers, so we can study what each component contributes by recombining saved answers, without calling a model again.
blocks.zh: 这种设计有三个实际好处. 它不需要培训数据,因为每个问题都由一般指导法官来回答。 文档属性不取决于查询,所以我们一次描述每个文档,然后重复使用每个触及它的查询的配置. 最后,每个分数都可以被追溯到单个的答案,这样我们就可以研究每个组件通过重新组合被保存的答案而作出的贡献,而无需再次调用模型.

blocks.en: We describe DMReranker (Decision-Model Reranker), which parses an instruction into typed clauses and combines per-clause probabilities with a fixed product rule (Section 3 ). On InfoSearch it gives large gains in WISE and p-MRR over the published baselines on the same candidate pool, with no loss in plain relevance (Section 5 ). Section 6 reports offline ablations, a comparison with one combined question to the same judge, the reason for its lower SICR, and the cost of the run.
blocks.zh: 我们描述的是DMRanker(决定-模式-Ranker),它将一个指令分解为打字条款,并将每个声明概率与固定产品规则相结合(第3节)。 在InfoSearch上,它使WISE和p-MRR比同一候选人才库上公布的基线大有收益,没有明显的损失(第5节)。 第6节向同一法官报告离线事故,与一个综合问题进行比较,说明降低SICR的原因和运行费用。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Architecture of DMReranker. (1) An LLM parses the instructed query into a topic and typed clauses, and a second pass removes clauses it cannot support. (2) For each query and candidate, a small judge model answers a four-level relevance question and one yes/no question per remaining rule. (3) The same judge profiles every document once over six fixed attributes. When its confidence on an attribute that a rule needs is below 0.3, a larger judge answers again. Plain code multiplies the probabilities into the final score s ⁡ ( d ) s(d) . Blue boxes call a model, the grey box does not.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early work on instructions in retrieval used them to describe the task, such as “retrieve a passage that answers this question” ( Asai and others, 2023 ; Su and others, 2023 ) . Later benchmarks asked whether models follow instructions that change the meaning of relevance for a single query. FollowIR measures this with p-MRR, which compares rankings before and after the instruction is changed ( Weller and others, 2025a ) . INSTRUCTIR attaches user-specific instructions to queries ( Oh and others, 2024 ) . Promptriever trains a bi-encoder retriever to respond to prompts ( Weller and others, 2025b ) . InfoSearch, which we use, isolates six document-level conditions and evaluates each in an original, an instructed and a reversely instructed mode ( Zhou and others, 2025 ) . Its two metrics, WISE and SICR, reward a model only when the ranking moves in the direction the instruction asks for.
blocks.zh: 关于检索指示的早期工作利用这些指示来描述这项任务,例如“检索一个回答这个问题的段落”(Asai等,2023;Su等,2023)。 后来的基准询问模型是否遵循改变单一查询相关性含义的指示. 跟随 IR用p-MRR衡量这一点,比较改变指令前后的排名(Weller等,2025a) 。 。 。 。 INSTORUCTIR在查询中附上了用户特有的指令(Oh等,2024.). Flaurriever培训了双编码器取回器以响应快取(Weller等,2025b. 我们使用的InfoSearch将6个文档级别条件隔离,并用正本,指示和倒向指示模式(周等,2025年)对每个条件进行评估. 它的两个度量衡,WISE和SICR,只在排名向指令要求的方向移动时奖励一个模型.

blocks.en: LLMs can rerank point-wise, by scoring one document at a time, pairwise, or list-wise, by ordering a window of documents ( Sun and others, 2023 ; Qin and others, 2024 ) . Setwise prompting reduces the calls of pairwise ranking ( Zhuang and others, 2024b ) , and Rank1 trains a reranker to reason before it answers ( Weller and others, 2025c ) . RankVicuna and RankZephyr distil list-wise ranking into open 7B models ( Pradeep et al., 2023a ; Pradeep et al., 2023b ) . Point-wise rerankers that read out label probabilities, rather than a single yes or no, give finer and better calibrated scores ( Zhuang and others, 2024a ) . Our relevance question follows this idea with a four-level scale. The difference is that we do not ask one model to fold the conditions into its relevance judgement. Each condition receives its own question and its own probability.
blocks.zh: LLMS可以通过一次给一个文档打分,对等,或按列表顺序,通过命令一个文档窗口(Sun等,2023;秦等,2024. Rank1在回答问题之前, 训练了一架重新排行机( Weller等, 2025c ) 。 RankVicuna和RankZephyr按列表顺序分解为开放式7B型(Pradeep等,2023a;Pradeep等,2023b.). 读出标签概率的点心再排行榜,而不是单行是或否,给出更精细,更好的分数( Zhu等,2024a. 我们的关联性问题以四级规模遵循这一想法。 不同的是,我们不要求一种模式将条件纳入其相关性判断。 每个条件都得到自己的问题和概率.

blocks.en: Splitting a complex task into simpler steps is a common way to make LLM behaviour more reliable, both for reasoning ( Zhou and others, 2023 ; Khot and others, 2023 ) and for evaluation, where a long text is checked one atomic fact at a time ( Min and others, 2023 ) . In retrieval, the closest analogue is filtering by metadata, which works when documents carry clean fields such as language or date. Web documents rarely do. Our document profile plays the role of these missing fields, filled in by a model and kept as probability distributions rather than hard labels, so that an uncertain attribute lowers a score without removing the document outright. Multiplying beliefs about separate conditions is old, as in the #and operator of inference networks ( Turtle and Croft, 1991 ) , soft conjunction in extended Boolean retrieval ( Salton et al., 1983 ) and products of experts ( Hinton, 2002 ) . What is new here is how the factors are obtained.
blocks.zh: 将复杂的任务分成更简单的步骤,是使LLM行为更加可靠的一种常见方式,既用于推理(周等,2023;克特等,2023)也用于评价,其中一长篇文字一次检查一个原子事实(明等,2023). 在检索中,最接近的模拟是通过元数据过滤,当文档携带语言或日期等干净的字段时,元数据就起作用了. 网页文档很少这样做. 我们的文件配置文件扮演着这些缺失字段的作用,由模型填充并保存为概率分布而非硬标签,这样一个不确定的属性在不直接删除文档的情况下会降低分数. 对不同条件的多重信仰是古老的,例如在推论网络的#和操作者(Turtle和Croft,1991年),在扩展布尔检索(Salton等,1983年)和专家产品(Hinton,2002年)中软结合. 这里的新情况是如何获得这些因素。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: DMReranker takes an instructed query q q and a list of candidate documents and returns a score s ⁡ ( d ) s(d) for each candidate. It works in three steps. Only the first two call a model.
blocks.zh: DMRanker 使用一个指令查询 q q 和一个候选文件列表,并返回每个候选者的分数 s Q (d) s (d) 。 以三相相行相通为通. 只有前两个叫模特儿.

blocks.en: 3.1 Parsing the instruction
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 解析指令

blocks.en: A parser model (Gemma-4-26B-A4B, a mixture-of-experts model with about 4B active parameters ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) ) reads the query and returns a structured policy p p in JSON. The policy has four parts. The topic is one sentence that states the information need with every condition removed. Attribute rules restrict a document attribute to a set of allowed values, for example audience ∈ { \in\{ general } \} . Other rules cover conditions that do not fit an attribute. Each is a yes/no question about the document, together with the answer that keeps it, for example “Does the document mention FooDB 3?” with keep-if yes . Metadata rules cover dates and versions, such as “published after 2023” or “most recent first”.
blocks.zh: 一个解析器模型(Gemma-4-26B-A4B,一种具有约4B活性参数的专家混合模型(Google DeepMind, 2026))读取了询问并返回了JSON中的结构化政策p. 政策分为四部分. 专题是一句话,说明信息需要,每个条件都去掉。 属性规则将文档属性限制在一组被允许的值上,例如受众 {{\\\\\\ 普通}\\\ 。 其他规则涵盖不符合属性的条件. 每个问题都是关于该文件的“是/否”问题,以及保留该文件的答案,例如“文件提到FooDB 3吗?” 元数据规则涵盖日期和版本,如“2023后公布”或“最近公布的第一”。

blocks.en: A second call to the same model checks the parse. It sees the query and the parsed rules and votes to keep or drop each rule, and it may rewrite the topic. It cannot add rules or change their content, so it can only make the policy more conservative. This step exists because a parser that invents a rule does more damage than one that misses a rule. An invented gate can push the only relevant document out of the top ten, while a missed rule leaves the ranking no worse than a plain relevance reranker.
blocks.zh: 同一型号的第二通电话检查剖面 它看到询问和解析的规则以及保留或放弃每项规则的投票,它可能会改写话题. 它不能增加规则或改变其内容,因此只能使政策更加保守. 这一步骤之所以存在,是因为一个发明规则的解说者所造成的损害比错过规则的多. 一个被发明的门可以将唯一相关的文档推出前十名,而一个被忽略的规则留下的排名并不比一个平庸的相关再排行榜差.

blocks.en: 3.2 Asking the judge
blocks.zh: 3.2 询问法官

blocks.en: The judge is Clef-flash, a 9B model served on Cloudflare Workers AI that answers typed questions about a text and returns a probability distribution over the possible answers ( Cloudflare, 2026 ) . It supports three question types that we use, a yes/no question, a choice among named options, and a score on an ordered scale.
blocks.zh: 法官是Clef-flash,在Cloudflare Workers AI上服务的一个9B型号,该型号解答了对文本的打出的问题,并返回了可能的解答的概率分布(Cloudflare, 2026). 它支持我们使用的3个问题类型,一个是/否问题,一个命名选项的选择,以及一个按顺序的分数.

blocks.en: For each candidate document d d we ask six choice questions in one request, one per attribute: source, format, audience, length, language and status. Each attribute has a fixed set of options. The answer is a distribution P ⁡ ( o ∣ d ) P(o\mid d) over the options of that attribute, together with a confidence value. These questions do not mention the query, so the profile of a document is computed once and shared by every query whose candidate list contains it. We wrote the attribute list with the six InfoSearch conditions in mind, and status was added for versioned documentation, so the profile fits this benchmark more closely than a list written for a new domain would. Its language options, for instance, are only English, Chinese and other. If a rule depends on an attribute whose confidence is below τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 , the larger Clef model (27B) answers the profile again for that document, and its distribution replaces only the low-confidence attributes.
blocks.zh: 对于每个候选文件 dd 我们在一个请求中提出六个选择问题,每个属性一个:来源、格式、受众、长度、语言和地位。 每个属性都有一套固定的选项. 答案是该属性的选项的P Q (o ∣ d) P(o\ mid d) 分布,并带有置信值. 这些问题没有提及查询,因此,文件的概况是一次性的,由候选人名单中包含的每个查询共享。 我们写了属性列表,记着六个信息搜索条件,并且为已版本文档添加了状态,因此配置比为新域所写的列表更符合这个基准. 例如,其语言选择只有英文、中文等。 如果一个规则依赖于一个属性,其置信度低于\\ 0.3\tau=0.3,那么更大的克勒夫模型(27B)再次为该文件解答了剖面,而其分布只取代了低自信属性.

We use the probability that the level is at least 2, P use ​ ( d ) = P ⁡ ( ℓ ≥ 2 ∣ d , topic ) . P_{\text{use}}(d)=P(\ell\geq 2\mid d,\text{topic}). (1) Asking about the parsed topic rather than the raw query matters. The raw query still contains the instruction, and a judge that sees “for non-experts” in the relevance question may fold the condition into its relevance estimate, which would count the condition twice.

blocks.en: Date and version rules become yes/no questions in the same way, and “most recent” becomes a pairwise recency factor between candidates. We write the product of these factors as m ⁡ ( d ) m(d) . InfoSearch does not grade documents by date, so m ⁡ ( d ) = 1 m(d)=1 for most queries. A few instructions still ask for “the latest” or “current” information, which the parser turns into a recency rule in 46 of the 4,791 query-mode rows (43 on Source). We kept these rules and measure their effect in Section 6.1 .

blocks.en: InfoSearch has 600 core queries, 100 per dimension, and 6,392 documents ( Zhou and others, 2025 ) . Each core query comes with instructed versions that add a condition, and reversely instructed versions that ask for the opposite. The paper reports 1,598 instructed queries. The public release contains 1,597, because one Keyword query is missing, and we evaluate on the release as is. We report all six dimensions, Audience (210 instructed queries), Keyword (287), Format (300), Language (200), Length (300) and Source (300).
blocks.zh: InfoSearch拥有600个核心查询,每个维度100个,以及6,392个文档(周等,2025年). 每个核心查询都带有指令版本会添加一个条件,而反向指令版本则会请求相反. 该文件报告了1 598项指示查询。 公开发布包含1,597个,因为缺少一个关键词查询,我们评价发布情况如出一辙. 我们报告所有6个维度,观众(210个指示查询)、关键词(287个)、格式(300个)、语言(200个)、长度(300个)和来源(300个)。

blocks.en: Following the InfoSearch reranking protocol, every system reranks the published top-100 candidates from e5-mistral ( Wang and others, 2024 ) , in all three modes. Because the candidates and relevance labels are identical, the reranker rows in our tables are same-pool comparisons. BM25 and e5-mistral rows are full-corpus retrieval results and are shown for reference only.
blocks.zh: 在InfoSearch重新排序协议之后,每个系统都会从e5-mistral(Wang等,2024年)中将公布的上-100名候选者重新排列为所有三种模式. 因为候选人和关联性标签是相同的,所以我们表格中的重新排行是同一组的比较. BM25和e5相间行为全体取回结果并仅供参考而显示.

blocks.en: We use the official InfoSearch evaluation code for WISE, SICR and p-MRR, and pytrec_eval for nDCG@10 ( Järvelin and Kekäläinen, 2002 ) . WISE rewards a system when documents that satisfy the condition move up under the instruction and move down under the reverse instruction, with more weight on changes near the top of the ranking. SICR is stricter. It counts a query as followed only when the condition-satisfying document gains in the instructed mode and loses in the reversed mode. p-MRR, taken from FollowIR, measures the change in reciprocal rank between modes ( Weller and others, 2025a ) . For each dimension we compute 95% confidence intervals for our scores with a bootstrap over instructed queries (2,000 resamples) ( Efron and Tibshirani, 1993 ; Smucker et al., 2007 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们使用WISE、SICR和p-MR的官方信息搜索评价代码,以及nDCG@10的pytrec_eval(Järvelin和Kekäläinen,2002年)。 WISE奖励一个系统,当满足条件的文档在指令下向上移动并倒向指令下移动,对接近排行榜上位的变化有更大的分量. SICR更严格 它只计算在指定模式下条件满意文档增益后在倒转模式下丢失时的查询。 p-MRR,取自FollowIR,衡量模式之间的对等分级变化(Weller等,2025a.). 对每个维度,我们计算出95%的置信间隔,用靴子来覆盖指示的查询(2 000个复标) (Efron和Tibshirani,1993;Smucker等,2007.).

blocks.en: We did not rerun any baseline. All baseline numbers come from Tables 1 and 2 of the InfoSearch paper, which uses the same candidates, labels and evaluation code ( Zhou and others, 2025 ) . They cover point-wise rerankers (Mistral-7B-Instruct ( Jiang and others, 2023 ) , Llama-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori and others, 2024 ) and FollowIR-7B ( Weller and others, 2025a ) ) and list-wise rerankers (Mistral-7B-Instruct, Zephyr-7B- β \beta ( Tunstall and others, 2023 ) , RankVicuna ( Pradeep et al., 2023a ) , RankZephyr ( Pradeep et al., 2023b ) and GPT-4o ( OpenAI, 2024 ) ). InfoSearch reports p-MRR and nDCG@10 only as six-dimension averages, so we compare those as averages.

InfoSearch只报告p-MRR和nDCG@10为六分法平均值,所以我们比较这些平均值.

blocks.en: The parser ( @cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it ) and both judges ( @cf/cloudflare/clef-flash and @cf/cloudflare/clef ) are called through Cloudflare Workers AI. All prompts, question wordings, the confidence threshold and the combination rule were fixed before the test runs (Appendix A gives their full text), and we record a hash of this configuration with every result. During development we tried the pipeline on 60 instructed queries each from Format and Source, which are also in the test set, and lowered τ \tau from 0.5 to 0.3 to save cost. Without these 120 queries, WISE is 43.8 on Format and 67.3 on Source, against 45.3 and 65.2 on all queries. Responses are cached by request, so a rerun of the full evaluation makes no new calls and returns identical numbers.

blocks.en: 6.1 Which component does the work
blocks.zh: 6.1 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助) 哪个组成部分能起作用

blocks.en: Because Equation 2 is computed from saved answers, we can remove a factor and recompute the rankings without new model calls. Table 3 shows four variants, and Figure 4 in Appendix B breaks WISE down by dimension. With relevance only, WISE falls to about zero on every dimension ( − - 4.0 on average), which confirms that the gains come from the clause factors and not from a better relevance model. Since the relevance question already uses the parsed topic, this variant is a strong relevance reranker that simply ignores the conditions.
blocks.zh: 因为"方程式2"是从所保存的答案中计算出来的,所以我们可以去掉一个因子并重新计算排名,而不用新的模型调用. 表3显示四个变体,附录B图4按维度细分了WISE。 仅就相关性而言,WISE在每个方面都降到了大约零(-- 4.0平均),这证实了收益来自条款因素,而不是更适切的模式。 由于相关性问题已经使用了被解析出的主题,这个变体是一个很强的相关性再排行法,它只是忽略了条件.

blocks.en: The two kinds of clause split the work in an interpretable way. Removing the attribute gates collapses Audience ( − - 1.2), Language ( − - 9.1) and Source ( − - 0.9), halves Format (20.6) and Length (17.6), but leaves Keyword unchanged at 58.3. Removing the yes/no rules does the opposite. Keyword drops to 4.1, while Audience and Language barely move and Source loses 4.7 points. On Keyword the parser keeps a required term in the topic, where the relevance question checks it, and turns an excluded term into a yes/no rule (286 of 287 reversed queries). Most other conditions go to attributes. Format and Length use both, which is why they lose ground under either removal.
blocks.zh: 两种条款以可解释的方式将作品分割开来. 删除属性门会使观众(−--1.2),语言(−- 9.1)和源(−-0.9),半个格式(20.6)和长度(17.6)崩溃,但关键词不变为58.3. 取消“是/否”规则则恰恰相反。 关键词降为4.1分,而"观众与语言"(Auditence and Language)几乎没有移动,"源"(Source)损失了4.7分. 在关键词上,解析器在专题中保留一个必要的术语,其中相关性问题加以检查,并将一个被排除的术语变为是/否规则(287个倒置查询中有286个)。 其他条件大多是属性。 格式和长度都使用这两个方法,这就是为什么它们在任何一种清除下都失去根据。

blocks.en: We also checked the parse and the profile directly. The parser added no rule to any of the 1,597 original-mode queries. Against each document that the instruction makes irrelevant, the clause factors rank the document that meets it higher in 83.2% of pairs in the instructed mode and 90.0% in the reversed mode. Instructed Keyword is lowest (53.3%), since its term stays in the topic, and the other dimensions range from 85.1% (Length) to 99.0% (Language).
blocks.zh: 我们还直接检查了剖面和剖面图。 解析器在1,597个原始模式查询中,没有增加任何规则. 针对指令不相关的每个文档,条款因素在指令模式的83.2%对和倒置模式的90.0%对满足它的文件进行排序. 被指示的关键词是最低的(53.3%),因为它的术语停留在话题中,其他维度从85.1%(Length)到99.0%(语言).

blocks.en: The metadata factor is the one component that does not help. Removing it leaves five dimensions within 0.5 WISE points, but on Source it raises WISE from 65.2 to 67.6 and p-MRR from 74.8 to 81.7. The recency rules on Source come from instructions that ask for the latest information, so the parser read them correctly. InfoSearch, however, labels Source documents by the kind of source and not by date, and reordering candidates by date adds noise to that judgement. The factor was also the most expensive part of the run (Section 6.4 ). We report the frozen system as it was run and do not remove the factor after the fact.
blocks.zh: 元数据因子是一个没有帮助的部分. 移除后,在0.5 WISE点内留下了5个维度,但在源上,WISE从65.2到67.6,p-MRR从74.8到81.7. 关于Source的惯用规则来自要求提供最新信息的指示,因此解析器正确读取. 然而,InfoSearch按来源类型而不是按日期给原始文件贴上标签,并按日期重新排列候选人,给该判决增加了噪音。 该因素也是跑道中最昂贵的部分(第6.4节)。 我们报告被冻结的系统运行, 并且不会在事后消除这个因素。

blocks.zh: 表3:离线浮出水面,平均6个维. 每个变体重接全系统所保存的答案,所以没有做出新的模型调用. V5在看到测试结果后被试,不属于系统的一部分.

blocks.en: 6.2 Clause questions against one combined question
blocks.zh: 6.2 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助) 条款问题针对一个综合问题

blocks.en: The ablations show that the clause factors carry the gains, but they do not show that splitting the instruction is better than asking about it directly. Relevance only ignores the instruction, and the published baselines use other models. We therefore built a single-question baseline on the same judge. For each query and candidate, Clef-flash answers one yes/no question, whether the document is useful for the query including its instruction, and the probability of yes is the score. There is no parse, no profile and no product, and the question is yes/no rather than our four-level scale.
blocks.zh: 缩写表明,条款因素带有收益,但它们并没有表明拆分指令比直接询问要好. 相关性只忽略了指令,所公布的基线使用其他模型. 因此,我们为同一法官确定了单一问题基线。 对于每个查询和候选人,克莱夫-flash回答一个是/否的问题,文档是否对包括指令在内的查询有用,是的概率是得分. 没有剖析,没有剖析和产品,问题在于是/否,而不是我们的四级尺度。

blocks.en: To keep the cost small we ran this baseline on a subset of 50 instructed queries per dimension, 300 in total, drawn with a fixed random seed. The subset was fixed and recorded before any baseline call was made. Both systems are scored on exactly these queries in all three modes, and we compare them with a paired bootstrap over queries (2,000 resamples). The baseline needed 85,170 judge calls and cost $1.22 at list price.
blocks.zh: 为了保持成本小,我们用一个固定的随机种子绘制的每个维度的50个指令查询的子集来计算这个基线。 在发出基准呼吁之前,该子集已经固定并记录下来。 这两个系统都以所有三种模式对这些查询进行精确的打分,我们用一个对接的靴子来比对查询(2,000个复标). 基线需要85 170名法官打电话,按清单价格计算费用为1.22美元。

Differences are DMReranker minus the single question, with paired bootstrap 95% intervals.

blocks.en: Table 4 gives the result. Splitting the instruction raises WISE from 32.9 to 47.6 and p-MRR from 20.0 to 53.0, and both intervals exclude zero. DMReranker also has better nDCG@10 in all three modes, but in the original mode, which has no clauses, the gain comes from the four-level question and the parsed topic, not from splitting. On SICR the result reverses, and the single question is clearly ahead (37.0 against 20.3). Per dimension, the WISE gain is large on Audience ( + + 46.9) and Format ( + + 25.6) and within noise elsewhere, with the single question ahead on Source by 10.5 points. With 50 queries per dimension these intervals are wide, so we treat the macro difference as the main result.
blocks.zh: 表4给出了结果。 拆分指令将WISE从32.9提高到47.6,p-MRR从20.0提高到53.0,两个间隔都排除了0. DMRanker在所有三种模式中也有更好的nDCG@10,但在没有条款的原始模式中,收益来自四级问题和解析出的主题,而不是从分出. 在SICR上,结果反向,单个问题显然在前面(37.0对20.3). 按维度计算,WISE增益在观众(+ 46.9)和Format(+ 25.6)上以及其他地方的噪音内都很大,在Source上单个问题领先了10.5分. 每个维度有50个询问,这些间隔很宽,所以我们把宏观差异作为主要结果。

blocks.en: 6.3 Why SICR lags
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 为什么SICR落后

blocks.en: SICR asks whether the score of a document that satisfies the condition rises when the instruction is added. In our model every clause factor lies between 0 and 1, so adding a clause can never raise a score by itself. A matching document only gains if its relevance probability goes up, and that rarely happens, because the parser strips the condition from the topic and the topic is therefore nearly the same in both modes. Attribute gates help the matching document by pushing the other documents down, which is exactly what WISE and p-MRR measure, but its own score usually stays the same or falls a little. On Language, 159 of the 200 instructed queries have an SICR of zero, and in most of them the instructed-mode score of the matching document is slightly lower than its original-mode score.
blocks.zh: SICR 询问满足条件的文档的分数在添加指令时是否上升. 在我们的模型中,每个条款因素都位于0到1之间,所以增加一个条款本身永远不能提高分数. 匹配文档只有在其关联概率上升的情况下才会有所增益,而这很少发生,因为解析器将条件从话题中剥离出,因此在两种模式中,话题几乎相同. 属性门通过将其他文档推倒来帮助匹配文档,这正是WISE和p-MRR的测量结果,但其自己的分数通常保持不变或稍有下降. 在"语言"方面,200个指令性查询中有159个SICR为0,在大多数查询中,匹配文档的指令性-模式分数略低于其原模式分数.

blocks.en: Two further results support this reading. The single question asks about the instruction directly, so a matching document can gain score, and its SICR is much higher than ours (Section 6.2 ). The post-hoc variant V5 (Table 3 ) replaces the product with a mean, which lets a passed clause add to the score. SICR rises from 19.2 to 33.0 while WISE falls from 50.9 to 47.4. V5 was chosen after seeing test results, so we report it only as evidence about the metric.
blocks.zh: 另有两项结果支持这一解读。 单个问题直接询问指令,因此匹配文档可以获得分数,其SICR比我们高得多(第6.2节. 后荷克变体V5(表3)用正值来取而代之,让一个通过的条款来增加分数. SICR从19.2上升到33.0,而WISE则从50.9下降到47.4. V5是在看到测试结果后被选中的,所以我们报告它只是作为衡量标准的证据.

blocks.en: The official code compares the raw scores of the matching document across the three runs. InfoSearch does not say how scores were assigned to the output of list-wise rerankers. If they come from ranks, SICR reduces to its rank conditions, which a gate that pushes other documents down does meet. Scoring our runs by rank raises our SICR from 19.2 to 67.0, and on the 300-query subset it reverses the comparison with the single question (67.0 against 52.0). SICR values are thus comparable only between systems whose scores are formed the same way.
blocks.zh: 官方代码比较了匹配文档在三跑的原始分数. InfoSearch没有说明如何将分数分配给列表重排的输出 。 如果他们来自军衔,SICR会降低到其军衔条件,一个将其他文件推倒的门确实会满足. 按级别计算我们的运行将我们的SICR从19.2提高到67.0,在300克的子集上,它颠倒了与单一问题的比较(67.0对52.0). 因此,SICR值只在得分相同的系统之间进行比较。

blocks.en: 6.4 Cost
blocks.zh: 6.4 费用

blocks.en: Scoring all six dimensions took 695,393 Clef-flash calls and about 274 million input tokens, which comes to about $10.4 at the Workers AI list price, or about two thirds of a cent per instructed query. Appendix C breaks this down by dimension (Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: 6个维度都做了695 393 Clef-flash呼叫和约2.74亿个输入符,以工人AI列表出价约10.4美元,或每个指令查询约三分之二. 附 录 C按维度细分(表7)。

blocks.en: We did not run GPT-4o, but counting the tokens of the actual candidates under the sliding-window setup of InfoSearch and pricing them at the GPT-4o list price gives about $486 for the same 4,791 rankings, roughly 47 times our cost (Appendix C ). The two prices come from different providers, so the ratio is only a rough guide.
blocks.zh: 我们没有运行GPT-4o,而是计算InfoSearch的滑窗设置下的实际候选人的代币,按GPT-4o列表价格定价,同4,791个排名给出了约486美元,大约是我们成本的47倍(附录C). 两种价格来自不同的提供商,因此这个比例只是粗略的向导.

blocks.en: Most of our cost comes from one component. A “most recent” rule compares every pair of the 100 candidates in both orders, 9,900 calls per query. The 43 Source rows with such a rule asked 425,700 pair questions, 415,800 of them unique because two rows share their topic and candidates. That is 60% of all judge calls, and Section 6.1 shows they did not improve the ranking.
blocks.zh: 我们的费用大部分来自一个部分。 一项“最近”的规则比较了两个订单中的每对100名候选人,每次查询9 900次。 43个有这种规则的源行提出了425,700个对对的问题,其中415,800个是独特的,因为两行都分享了他们的话题和候选人. 这占所有法官电话的60%,第6.1节显示他们没有提高排名.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We showed that a reranker can follow document-level instructions well without any training, by turning the instruction into small questions that a judge model can answer and multiplying the answers. The clause questions carry the gains, and on the same judge, splitting the instruction raises WISE from 32.9 to 47.6 over one combined question, although raw-score SICR falls because the product rule cannot raise a score. On InfoSearch, this simple design scores well above the published GPT-4o result on average WISE and on four of the six dimensions, keeps plain relevance intact, and costs under one cent per instructed query. We think the same pattern (parse once, profile once, ask narrow questions and combine in code) is worth trying wherever the conditions users state can be named in advance as document attributes.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,重新排名者可以在没有任何训练的情况下很好地遵守文件一级的指示,将指示变成一个法官模型可以回答的小问题,并增加答案。 条款问题带有收益,而在同一法官中,将指令分开,将WISE从32.9提高到47.6,比一个综合问题高,尽管原始分数SICR下降,因为产品规则不能提高分数。 在InfoSearch上,这种简单的设计得分远远高于公布的GPT-4o平均WISE和6个维度中的4个的成绩,保持了纯相关性完好无损,每个指令查询的费用低于1%. 我们认为同一模式(parse once, profile once, profile, 问出狭义的问题并合并到代码中)值得尝试,只要条件用户可以预先命名为文档属性.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning has improved instruction following in retrieval models ( Weller and others, 2025a ; Weller and others, 2025b ; Zhou and others, 2025 ) , and training our judge on attribute and rule questions, for example with labels from a larger model, could sharpen its answers.
blocks.zh: 微调改进了检索模型的教学(Weller等,2025a;Weller等,2025b;Zhou等,2025),并对我们的法官进行属性和规则问题的培训,例如用更大的模型的标签,可以使其答案更加清晰。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The single-question comparison covers a random subset of 300 instructed queries, not the full benchmark, so its per-dimension results are noisy. Apart from that baseline, our baseline numbers are cited from the InfoSearch paper and not reproduced. The candidate pools, labels and evaluation code are the same, but we cannot rule out small differences in evaluation details. The public release has one Keyword query fewer than the paper, so our Keyword average is over 287 queries rather than 288.
blocks.zh: 单题比较涵盖一个由300个指令查询组成的随机子集,而不是完整的基准,因此其每分题结果很吵. 除此基线外,我们的基准数字取自InfoSearch文件,没有转载。 候选人才库,标签和评价代码相同,但我们不能排除评价细节的微小差异. 公开发布时有一个关键词查询比论文少,因此我们的关键词平均有超过287个查询,而不是288个.

blocks.en: The system depends on hosted models. We pin model identifiers and cache every response, which makes our numbers reproducible from the cache, but a provider may update a hosted model in place. The judge has open weights, and a local rerun would remove this dependence.
blocks.zh: 系统依赖于主机模型. 我们锁定模型识别器 并缓存每个响应, 这使得我们的数字可以从缓存中复制, 但提供者可以更新一个主机模型。 法官的权重是开放的,当地重播会消除这种依赖性.

blocks.en: The parser can add rules that the benchmark does not grade. On InfoSearch it added a recency rule to 46 query-mode rows. Each of these matched wording in the instruction, so none was a parse error, but InfoSearch does not grade recency, and on Source the factor lowered scores slightly while adding most of the cost. A parser that invents a rule could do more harm, since a wrong gate can remove a relevant document. The self-check step reduces this risk without removing it.
blocks.zh: 解析器可以添加基准不分级的规则. 在InfoSearch上,它在46个查询-模式行中添加了复写规则. 指令中每个对应的措辞,所以没有一个是解析错误,但InfoSearch不进行分级复读,在Source上,因子在增加大部分成本的同时略微降低分数. 一个发明规则的解析器可能做更多的伤害,因为错误的门可以去除相关的文档. 自我检查步骤可以减少这种风险,而不消除这种风险。

blocks.en: We evaluate on a single benchmark. InfoSearch conditions map cleanly onto document attributes, which suits our design, and our attribute list was written with them in mind. A new domain needs its own list, and we have not measured how much a list written without the benchmark in view would lose. Instructions that redefine relevance in subtler ways, as in FollowIR, may need more yes/no rules and fewer attribute gates. A first attempt to reproduce the FollowIR candidate pool did not match the published first-stage numbers, so we leave FollowIR to future work rather than report numbers on a pool we cannot verify. Finally, the method needs one judge call per candidate and question. From an empty cache a ranking needed 145 judge calls on average, or 58 without the Source recency pairs, where GPT-4o needs 9 list-wise windows. The calls are small and independent, so they can run in parallel and latency depends more on the provider’s concurrency than on their number. We did not measure latency.
blocks.zh: 我们只用一个基准来评估。 InfoSearch 条件映射到文档属性上, 这适合我们的设计, 我们的属性列表是用它们来写的 。 一个新域需要它自己的列表,我们没有衡量一个列表在没有基准的情况下会损失多少. 以更微妙的方式重新界定相关性的指示,如FollowIR,可能需要更多的是/否规则和更少的属性门. 第一次尝试复制"FollowIR"候选集合,与已公布的第一阶段数字不符,因此我们让FollowIR去未来的工作,而不是在无法核实的集合上报告数字. 最后,这种方法需要一名法官传唤每个候选人并提问。 从空的缓存中,平均需要145名法官调用,或者58名法官没有源重任对,GPT-4o需要9个列表窗口。 这些电话是小型的,并且是独立的,因此可以平行运行,而暂时性更多地取决于提供者的货币,而不是数字。 我们没有衡量延迟。

blocks.en: We did not run GPT-4o. InfoSearch follows the sliding-window setup of RankZephyr ( Pradeep et al., 2023b ; Sun and others, 2023 ) , which ranks the top 100 candidates in 9 windows of 20 with a stride of 10. For each of the 4,791 rankings, we counted the tokens of the actual candidate texts with the GPT-4o tokenizer ( o200k_base ), added 150 prompt tokens per window for the template and the query, and assumed 110 output tokens per window for the ranked list of identifiers. Windows overlap, so each ranking reads 180 candidate slots, which we priced at the mean candidate length of that ranking. This gives 43,119 calls, 175.5 million input tokens and 4.7 million output tokens. At the GPT-4o list price of $2.50 per million input and $10 per million output tokens, the total is about $486.
blocks.zh: 我们没有运行GPT-4o。 InfoSearch遵循了RankZephir的滑窗设置(Pradeep等,2023b;Sun等,2023b),在9个窗口中排名前100名的候选人以10名的出场. 对于4,791个排名中的每一个排名,我们用GPT-4o的标注器(o200k_base)计算出实际候选文本的符号,为模板和查询每个窗口增加了150个即时符号,为排名识别器列表假设每个窗口有110个出品符. Windows重叠,所以每个排名都读取了180个候选名额,我们以该排名的平均候选时间长度来定价. 这给43,119个电话,1.755亿个输入信使和470万个产出信使. GPT-4o列表价格为每百万投入2.5美元和每百万产出令牌10美元,共计约486美元.

blocks.en: Apart from the recency pairs, cost follows document length more than query count. Since profiles are computed once per document, a new query adds only its relevance and rule questions. A single choice question over the whole list, or sorting on an extracted date, would remove nearly all of the extra cost on Source.
blocks.zh: 除复用对外,费用还比查询数更符合文件长度。 由于配置文件每次计算一次,新的查询只增加其相关性和规则问题。 对整个清单的单一选择问题,或在取出的日期进行排序,将消除来源的几乎所有额外费用。
